title: Open Call for Proposals for Pulitzer Center’s AI Accountability Fellowships (2026–2027)

budget.quote: Journalists selected as AI Accountability Fellows will be provided up to $25,000 (up to $20,000 for reporting and $5,000 for engagement activities) to pursue their reporting projects.

summary.value: The Pulitzer Center is offering fellowships providing financial support, mentorship, and training to journalists reporting on artificial intelligence systems.
summary.quote: Through the AI Accountability Fellowships, the Pulitzer Center aims to support in-depth, high-impact reporting projects that document and explain the opportunities, harms, and regulatory and labor issues surrounding AI systems.

eligibility.quote: The Pulitzer Center is recruiting eight to 10 journalists from around the world to report on the impacts of algorithmic and automated systems on their communities.
